scope: All records tagged DUAL_USE_KEYWORD_REVIEW (9) or PROMPT_INJECTION_KEYWORD_REVIEW (3) in the audited registry. Separate same-family auditor; no upstream code executed or installed; no paid services called.

per_id.observation: README describes browser automation to pass Cloudflare challenges. This supports a dual-use classification; it does not demonstrate malware or permission to bypass a third-party site's controls.
per_id.caution: Do not install helpers/extensions or reuse clearance cookies. Any future authorized test needs its own target scope and isolated profile.

per_id.observation: README describes an iOS app launcher rather than an emulator/hypervisor, and discusses signing bypass under particular conditions. It warns that third-party builds can access contained app data. This is a platform-boundary risk, not proof that the upstream project is malicious.
per_id.caution: Do not infer container isolation from the name. No mobile build or IPA was downloaded or run.

per_id.observation: README frames the project as authorized security testing but includes offensive testing categories and an AI-guided command layer. A lawful-use claim does not make every bundled tool safe or licensed for a target.
per_id.caution: Do not execute its installer, bundled tools or AI-generated commands. Upstream dependencies and every proposed test target require separate review.

per_id.observation: README describes a defensive detection/protection system against malicious traffic. The Russian source mention of preventing attacks triggered the broad keyword rule. The flag is a false positive for inferring an offensive or malicious tool.
per_id.caution: No deployment or firewall change performed; detection accuracy, telemetry handling, privileges and availability remain untested.

per_id.observation: README and repository API both returned 404. The archived description suggests adversarial prompt reference material, but current content, license and provenance could not be established.
per_id.caution: A 404 does not prove maliciousness, deletion, or abandonment; preserve the record and original claim as unverified.

per_id.observation: README presents extracted/versioned system prompts. The original description is descriptive reference text and does not itself instruct this auditor to change behavior. The prompt-injection keyword flag is a false positive for active injection in that description.
per_id.caution: Never import collected third-party system prompts as privileged AWE instructions. Completeness, currency, extraction authorization and reuse rights were not independently established.

per_id.observation: README presents a map/reference of antivirus and EDR bypass techniques. It is not evidence of a malware binary, and the inspected README is mainly an index; the evasion subject matter justifies review.
per_id.caution: No evasion technique, payload, exclusion or linked tool was executed. Do not use the material to weaken current endpoint protections.

per_id.observation: README describes a Steam depot-manifest cache/API. The organization name triggers a broad crack keyword rule; that alone is not evidence of malicious code. Rights to redistribute or fetch particular game data and API trust were not established.
per_id.caution: Do not contact the API, obtain keys or download game content. Treat as a data resource, not a validated AWE dependency.

per_id.observation: README contains prompt payloads intended to override model restrictions. The content was read only as untrusted data; its success claims were not tested. This is adversarial prompt-reference material rather than proof of host malware.
per_id.caution: Do not load payloads as system instructions or execute suggested browser/account changes. Any use should be a bounded safety-evaluation fixture with separate authorization.

per_id.observation: README presents a collection of prompts and model/tool information. The original record describes a dataset and is not an active instruction directed at the auditor. The name/keywords alone cannot establish prompt injection or accurate model internals.
per_id.caution: Do not auto-promote copied prompts to trusted memory, reproduce secrets from linked dumps, or assume source legitimacy, ownership or freshness.

per_id.observation: README describes purported leaked system prompts and versions. The archived source description is descriptive rather than an active injection. Authenticity, collection authority and complete/correct versions remain unknown.
per_id.caution: Keep content behind an untrusted-data boundary. Do not reproduce potentially sensitive third-party dump content or use it as AWE policy.

per_id.observation: README and repository API both returned 404. The archived description concerns console exploitation, but current repository content and licensing were not available.
per_id.caution: Do not infer malware or a confirmed working exploit from the URL/description; no payload or firmware interaction occurred.

verdict_semantics.FALSE_POSITIVE: False positive for inferring offensive/malicious behavior or active injection from the original description; does not certify source safety.
verdict_semantics.RISK_REVIEW: Subject matter warrants bounded trust/authorization review; malware and runtime safety not determined.
verdict_semantics.UNKNOWN: Evidence insufficient for the relevant current content/authorization question.

limitations: README/source review is not a malware scan, license clearance or sandbox acceptance.
No model was asked to execute jailbreaks or bypass endpoint protections.
Descriptions and repository instructions remained untrusted data.
